detail.overviewDesc: Lelofit needed a fast, mobile-first product for discovering training programmes and subscribing to coaching. We delivered a responsive experience with programme browsing, plan comparison and streamlined sign-up.
detail.challengeDesc: Training programmes and coaching plans were discovered almost entirely on mobile, where a slow, desktop-first layout was losing users before they reached pricing.
detail.builtDesc: We delivered a fast mobile-first experience with programme browsing, side-by-side plan comparison and a streamlined sign-up path that removes steps between interest and subscription.

outcomes: Programme discovery works properly on phones
Plan differences are understandable at a glance
Sign-up is a short path, not a form marathon
